notes: zh-CN-TS-01 (MINOR, ui.chat.thread_search.count.split) - RESOLVED at 58de30166d. The new form is 精确：{exactText} · 相关：{relatedText}. My finding was that a bare adjective glued to a numeral (精确3) gave the same status slot two incompatible count shapes and dropped the 条 classifier its siblings carry. The label-first shape answers that at the root: 精确：3 is a label:number pair, where Chinese expects no classifier (cf. 总计：3), and it now mirrors the English 'Exact: 3 · Related: 1' rather than an English word order the locale could not copy. Checked against my own reasoning rather than the commit message: the pair is stable for 1/2/21, both labels reuse the stems of the sibling lines (相关 also backs tier.related 相关匹配), and the full-width colon is the correct zh punctuation with no space before the digits.
